summary: Neuraxis filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its at-the-market offering agreement with Craig-Hallum Capital Group, increasing the aggregate offering amount from $6,270,000 to $11,500,000. Through April 20, 2026, the company had sold 1,125,281 shares under the original agreement. The amendment, filed April 21, 2026, was accompanied by a prospectus supplement. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexities beyond the ATM mechanics are noted. There is no risk-arb angle to monitor.
